question.questionText: Что такое overlay2 storage driver и когда его менять?
question.shortAnswer: overlay2 — default storage driver на Linux, использует kernel OverlayFS: N read-only image layers + 1 writable container layer через copy-on-write. Менять только для ZFS/btrfs snapshot, fuse-overlayfs rootless, или legacy devicemapper. Смена wipes /var/lib/docker.
question.idealAnswer: overlay2 = OverlayFS + Docker. lowerdir (image layers) + upperdir (container writes) + workdir + merged view. Write: new file in upper; modify lower → copy-up entire file. Disk: /var/lib/docker/overlay2/, layer sharing via docker system df -v. Default с Docker 17.06+, ext4/xfs ftype=1. Альтернативы: btrfs/zfs для snapshot; fuse-overlayfs rootless; devicemapper deprecated; vfs без COW. Смена: stop docker, daemon.json storage-driver, rm -rf /var/lib/docker, restore from backup. Ошибки: switch без wipe; xfs ftype=0; loopback devicemapper; volumes отдельны от driver. Heavy writes → volumes/bind mounts bypass driver.

checkpoints.title: Определяет overlay2 и OverlayFS
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: overlay2 — default storage driver на Linux; kernel OverlayFS; N read-only layers + 1 writable container layer.

checkpoints.title: Описывает lowerdir/upperdir/merged
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: lowerdir=image layers, upperdir=writable changes, workdir, merged=container view; read top-down, write to upperdir.

checkpoints.title: Понимает copy-on-write и производительность
checkpoints.expected: Кандидат: modify lower file → copy entire file to upper; 5GB touch = 5GB copy; reads near-native; heavy writes → volumes/bind mounts.

checkpoints.title: Знает когда менять driver
checkpoints.expected: Кандидat: ZFS/btrfs если уже используете; fuse-overlayfs для rootless; devicemapper legacy; 99% оставить overlay2.

checkpoints.title: Проверяет driver и disk usage
checkpoints.expected: Кандидat: docker info Storage Driver; docker system df -v; layer sharing — 100 nginx = nginx_size + 100*upper, не 100*nginx.

checkpoints.title: Знает процедуру смены driver
checkpoints.expected: Кандидat: destructive — wipe /var/lib/docker; stop daemon; storage-driver в daemon.json; backup images/volumes first.

checkpoints.title: Знает типичные ошибки
checkpoints.expected: Кандидat: switch без wipe; xfs без ftype=1; loopback devicemapper; путать storage driver с volumes.

checkpoints.title: Понимает metacopy (упоминание)
checkpoints.expected: Кандидat: metacopy=on — copy-up только metadata chmod/chown без data; off по умолчанию.
